scope: Strategy-only attention and secondary-benefit context for the bounded economic comparison. It ranks no method and never turns a possible output into an account-state result.

agility_pyramid.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, desert supplies or attention no longer fit, or a new commitment becomes earlier.

secondary_benefit_categories: deterministic shop access after observed reputation
giants_foundry.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, commission inputs change, or an observed shop objective takes priority.

wealthy_citizen_valuables.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, the observed attention window changes, or a different declared commitment becomes earlier.

silk_stalls.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, the sale delay or guard management no longer fits, or a new commitment becomes earlier.

blackjacking.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, attention or risk tolerance changes, or the player no longer wants the high-intensity method.

secondary_benefit_categories: bounty parts for current voyage context
sailing_bounty_tasks.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, task availability changes, or a different Sailing objective is declared.

shipwreck_salvaging.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, shipwreck availability or boat preparation changes, or a different account objective needs the supplies.

port_roberts_stalls.stop_reentry: Reassess when the named funding commitment is later observed funded, guard timing or arrest risk no longer fits, or a different declared commitment becomes earlier.
